profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a publicly traded Australian software company, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, that makes collaboration and project management tools for software, IT, and business teams. Its core products include Jira, Confluence, Trello, Loom, and Rovo, and the company describes its platform as designed for teams and AI agents to plan, execute, and deliver work together. Atlassian trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker TEAM and reported revenue of approximately $5.215 billion for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing.

The company tracks two AI products on this site: Confluence AI, described as a team wiki assistant incorporating smart links, automation, and Atlassian Cloud governance, and Trello AI, described as offering project management AI and workflow automation within the same governance framework. The company describes its platform as designed to support evolving standards and regulatory requirements. No litigation or MCP server entries are held for Atlassian at this time.
